scope.frame: E6's cubic in trinification form on three families' 27s with a symmetric coupling
scope.object: the extended down-quark and charged-lepton mass matrices under any colour- and charge-keeping vev of the 27s
scope.hypotheses: eight random complex symmetric couplings and neutral vevs; main's own code from the invariance and Q_em = T3 + T8/sqrt3

claim_one_line: W139 ON MAIN (P-338; PROVED, no data): under E6's cubic N = det Q + det L + det Q^c - tr(Q L Q^c) (invariant under SU(3)^3 to 8e-16), with three families, a symmetric coupling and any vevs in the five neutral leptonic components, the extended down-type (d, D) and charged-lepton (e, E) mass matrices have the same singular values to 6e-16; doubling det L splits them (the control). So D = 1 for every 27 vev: the lepton factor 3 that B1726's ingredients put in by hand cannot come from the 27s' cubic; P-338 answered no; P-294 sharpens to a source outside the 27s. 0 of 19.
